content.name: Daniel O'Connell
content.title: Lead Business Analyst
content.summary: Lead business analyst with 17 years in banking, health insurance, transport and energy. Currently lead the business analysis chapter on a $52 million network asset management program at a Queensland energy distributor. Known for structured requirements, calm workshop facilitation and keeping regulatory obligations visible from discovery to go-live.

experience.title: Lead Business Analyst
bullets: Lead a chapter of eight business analysts on a $52 million asset management program covering maintenance planning, work orders and field mobility.
Built a regulatory obligations register linked to 1,400 requirements, so every safety and reporting obligation had an owner and a test case.
Facilitated design authority sessions with operations, IT and vendors, reaching decisions on 95 design questions within the planned timeframe.
Cut average requirements sign-off time from four weeks to nine days by introducing lighter templates and fortnightly review cycles.

experience.title: Senior Business Analyst
bullets: Led requirements for a contactless fare payment upgrade across 300 buses and ferries, working with operators and the payments vendor.
Modelled refund and dispute processes that reduced customer complaint handling time by 25%.
Mentored four analysts and ran the team's requirements quality review.

experience.title: Business Analyst
bullets: Specified changes to the claims system for annual private health insurance reforms, delivered each April on time.
Redesigned the hospital pre-approval process with provider relations, removing two manual hand-offs and saving 1,800 staff hours a year.
Wrote functional specifications and test cases for the member app's first release.

experience.title: Graduate Analyst
bullets: Rotated through lending operations, cards and IT, documenting processes for each team.
Analysed home loan application delays and helped shorten approval times by three business days.
Supported testing for a new internet banking release used by 120,000 customers.

achievements.title: Program award
achievements.detail: Granite Belt Energy executive award (2024) for requirements quality on the asset management program.

achievements.title: Speaker
achievements.detail: Presented on regulatory traceability at a Brisbane business analysis community event (2023).
